crore log ek saath GTA 6 download karenge…
kya internet ke servers melt ho jayenge?
Rockstar ke hisaab se GTA 6 ke liye
console mein 200 GB tak jagah chahiye.
India ka average internet speed 60 Mbps hai,
matlab download mein 7 ghante se bhi zyada!
Aur Jio ke 2 GB roz wale data se?
Ab socho, 2.5 crore log ek hi raat mein…
itna load koi bhi internet nahi jhel sakta.
Lekin GTA 6 ka preload 10 November se hi shuru hai,
Isliye game pehle se hi aapke console mein download ho jayega.
Raat 12 baje bas ek chhoti si unlock key aayegi,
aur phir aap GTA 6 khel sakte hain.
